quarterly_data.quarter: Dell press release: Dell Technologies Drives the Agentic AI Era with New (10-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Dell unified its deskside AI workstations under the Dell Pro Precision brand: Dell Pro Max with GB10 and Dell Pro Max with GB300 are now Dell Pro Precision with GB10 and Dell Pro Precision with GB300. Dell Pro Precision with GB300 (on Windows: 'coming soon') scales to 20 petaflops of FP4 compute and 748GB of coherent memory on the NVIDIA GB300 Grace Blackwell Ultra Desktop Superchip, supporting models up to 1 trillion parameters locally; Dell says its exclusive MaxCool technology sustains that performance with up to five times higher cooling efficiency.
quarterly_data.figure: 20 petaflops of FP4; 748GB coherent memory; models up to 1 trillion parameters; up to five times higher cooling efficiency
quarterly_data.counterparty_role: supplier (NVIDIA GB300 Grace Blackwell Ultra Desktop Superchip)
